ck: (24)petacantrika evanceti atnano tvitvakunasrayatvasanartanena travyatvasitavityanvaya kunasrayatvasanartanena travyatvasitavityarta cEtrasariraniti vyavaharikapetanataya sitasatanatavaranaya vastuta iti na caprasitavisesanateti vacyan vastuto nEtrasirirasvanitatatnyapanasvanikan na pavatityapavasatyakatvatatra ca satyaprasitirna tosa ityuktan prak virutacestakatvatiti nEtrasariracestavirutacestakasariratvatityarta evancEkasvanikayorkatapatayorna vyapicara prakuktananvayatrstantapavanankikrtya vyatirekatrstantanaha — nEtrasariraniti na ca kalapetena nEtrasarira eva kananakananayorvirutacestayortarsanatvyapicara iti vacyan ekakalavaceteneti hetuvisesanat na ca tatapi kantavatahanacnanatarsananukulavirutacestatarsanatintrarcunasarirayorvyapicara iti vacyan upayavatisanpratipanan yatekasvanikan tacunyatve satiti visesanat intrarcunasarirayostvavayorekasvanikatvasanpratipaterna vyapicara ata eva na sOparyatisarire vyapicara na caprayocakata parasparakatatukanusantanaprasankarupavipakse patakatarkasanatatvat ata eva nopatisatpratipaksapasasanyasanka civesvaraviti na ca civasyapi tarnitvatatsatasananasatakapetavatvan parasyapinataniti sitasatanateti vacyan tatotaratvat vatyakatukapavalaksana iti parasparatyantapavarupatvalaksanastatvyapyatvalaksano vetyarta tena nacata ekonyan hanti napyanyatara iti nyayena nasyanasakapava sanpavati ata evetaneva nyayanrtepi potyan alpasaktirasarvacnan paratantryanapurnata upacivakatvan civatvanisatvan tatviparyaya svapavikan tayoretananyata tu katancane tyatisruternasiti nanu sitantetyantapavasya tucanatrapratiyokikatvena sarvacnatvatinan parasparatyantapavarupatve tatvyapyatve va tucatvapati tatataratvasya pakse trstante casiti
